definitions.gloss: temple bell; large hanging Buddhist bell
definitions.explanation: A large bronze bell hung in a Buddhist temple and struck from the outside with a wooden beam. Best known for being rung 108 times on New Year's Eve.

examples.japanese: {遠|とお}く⟦で→で：00502_de⟧{梵鐘|ぼんしょう}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{鳴|な}っている→鳴る：01143_naru⟧。
examples.english: A temple bell is ringing in the distance.

examples.japanese: ⟦この→この：00962_kono⟧⟦{寺|てら}→寺：01676_tera⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{梵鐘|ぼんしょう}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{江戸時代|えどじだい}→江戸時代：20431_edojidai⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{作|つく}られた→作る：00481_tsukuru⟧。
examples.english: This temple's bell was cast in the Edo period.

examples.japanese: ⟦{大晦日|おおみそか}→大晦日：05810_oomisoka⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{除夜|じょや}の{鐘|かね}→除夜の鐘：16977_joyanokane⟧⟦として→として：06802_toshite⟧{梵鐘|ぼんしょう}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{百八回|ひゃくはちかい}⟦{突|つ}く→突く：12735_tsuku⟧。
examples.english: On New Year's Eve, the temple bell is struck 108 times as the joya-no-kane.

notes:
A large bronze temple bell, struck from outside by a swinging wooden beam ({撞木|しゅもく}) rather than an internal clapper.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {梵鐘|ぼんしょう}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{突|つ}く→突く：12735_tsuku⟧ / つく: to strike the temple bell
- {梵鐘|ぼんしょう}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{鳴|な}る→鳴る：01143_naru⟧: the temple bell rings

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{鐘|かね}→鐘：02654_kane⟧: bell — the general word for any bell
- ⟦{除夜|じょや}の{鐘|かね}→除夜の鐘：16977_joyanokane⟧: the New Year's Eve bell-ringing, traditionally 108 strikes of a {梵鐘|ぼんしょう}
